name: Serialization Phones Home
description:
The coinnectar wallet SDK added a “cross-version serialization compatibility layer.” It advertises a tidy list of telemetry endpoints — but one destination is assembled at runtime from an obfuscated host, and a snapshot ships to it the moment the module is imported.

Find the real delivery host and the function that fires on import. Submit HXN{<decoded_exfil_host>_<import_time_sink>}.
hints: Ignore the pretty endpoint list. Something is decoded into a host and contacted without anyone explicitly calling it.
